# Task queue

- [Task queue: how](plan.md) - A Go tool in tools/tasks reads the tasks from the knowledge and from git, keeps the marks of ready, the turn and the notes in an ignored folder of the main checkout, and runs the steps of a delivery.
- [Task queue: a tool for the work in flight](spec.md) - One command shows every task in flight and its state, starts a task's branch and worktree, marks work ready, gives one turn at a time, delivers at the turn and merges, with its state on disk so a closed session picks the work up again.
